title: The Effects of Daridorexant on Patients With Comorbid Insomnia Disorder and Untreated Mild Obstructive Sleep Apnoea: A Post Hoc Subgroup Analysis of a Phase 3, Randomised Clinical Trial
comparison_or_design: The selected daridorexant 50-mg and placebo comparison in the mild-OSA subgroup.
excluded: Daridorexant 25 mg, month-1 and participants without mild OSA
population_or_material: The post hoc subgroup with comorbid insomnia and untreated mild OSA in the phase 3 daridorexant study.
requested_items: Mild-OSA/COMISA selected 50-mg versus placebo subgroup: numerical baseline means, month-three LSM changes and placebo-adjusted contrasts. Exclude generic across-month descriptions, 25-mg results and other sleepiness endpoints.
case_specific_rules: For the selected mild-OSA subgroup at month three, use the coherent point estimate/CI/P combinations reported together in Supplementary Table S2 and matching the main Results. Retain Figure S1 discrepancies in review records; more decimal places alone do not establish precedence.
Keep the endpoint/model adjustment context and separate baseline observed summaries from model changes/contrasts. Do not combine an alternative figure estimate with table-only statistics.
